Author: B. Vijaysen Reddy
Bench: B. Vijaysen Reddy
 Honourable Sri Justice B. Vijaysen Reddy
 Writ Petition No.18147 Of 2024
Order :

(ORAL) This writ petition is filed by the petitioner seeking to declare the action of respondent No.3 - the Station House Officer, Women Police Station, West Zone, Yousufguda, in interfering with his personal life and liberty by calling him to the Police Station pursuant to the complaint lodged by respondent No.4, as being illegal, arbitrary and unconstitutional.

entities.text: Women Police Station, West Zone, Yousufguda
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home,
and perused the material available on record.
3.

Having received written instructions dated 10.07.2024 from the Sub-Inspector of Police, Women Police Station, Yousufguda, learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home submitted that on the complaint lodged by respondent No.4 (the wife of the petitioner) with respondent No.3, Crime No.143 of 2024 was registered with Women Police Station, Yousufguda, on 22.06.2024 for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 406 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code (IPC) and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
The petitioner is the accused No.1 in the said crime and the case is under investigation.
That only for the purpose of issuing notice under Section 41A of the Code of Criminal Procedure (Cr.P.C.), the petitioner and other accused were called to the Police Station.

4. In the circumstances, the writ petition is disposed of directing the petitioner to appear before respondent No.3, if necessary, with the assistance of an advocate, and receive the notice under Section 41A Cr.P.C. in Crime No.143 of 2024.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous applications, if any, pending in this writ petition stand closed.

B. VIJAYSEN REDDY, J Date. 10.07.2024 RRK Atluri Venkateshwara Rao vs The State Of Telangana on 10 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/46085459/
